classes.purpose: Understand the case and write a source-backed Deep Research prompt
classes.content: The question and facts typed or attached by the user, including names or other personal facts when material; inferred research framing; optimized prompt; source-domain sidecars; diagnostics and review decisions

external_boundaries.purpose: Curate qualified source domains for the confirmed legal framework and issue
external_boundaries.content: Legal or tax issue research terms and public-source URLs; queries can reflect case facts when the selected model runtime uses them
controls: The selected model runtime chooses domains from the confirmed framework; deterministic scripts do not choose legal sources.
The workflow does not request credentials or authenticated-source access.
